theorems.statement: let D : ℂ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun v ε => {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im ∧ ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖ ≤ ε}; ∀ (v : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < v.im → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∀ a b c d : ℝ, a * d - b * c = 1 → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((a : ℂ) * z + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * z + (d : ℂ)); M '' (D v ε) = D (M v) ε
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted upper-half-plane bijection and ratio-norm invariance lemmas to establish both set inclusions.
